name: terminay
description: A desktop terminal workspace built with Electron, React, and Vite.
author: Mark Wylde

scripts.dev: npm run build:app && node scripts/stage-selected-secure-werift-runtime.mjs && TERMINAY_WEBRTC_RUNTIME_ROOT="$PWD/build/webrtc-runtime" node scripts/run-canonical-development.mjs
scripts.build:app: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @terminay/server && npm run build:server-ui && tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.server-preload.config.ts && node scripts/build-ui-bundle-manifest.mjs dist $npm_package_version 1 remote.html
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:app && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:screenshots && npm --prefix docs run build
scripts.build:server-ui: npm run build --workspace @terminay/web && vite build --config vite.server-ui.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:server-ui-archive: npm run build:server-ui && node scripts/server-ui-archive-benchmark.mjs --renderer-directory dist-web --entry-path server.html
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @terminay/protocol && npm run build --workspace @terminay/client-core && npm run build --workspace @terminay/responsive-ui && npm run build:server-ui
scripts.build:applications: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @terminay/server && npm run build --workspace @terminay/desktop && npm run build --workspace @terminay/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @terminay/protocol --if-present && npm run build --workspace @terminay/client-core --if-present && npm run build --workspace @terminay/responsive-ui --if-present && npm run build --workspace @terminay/extension-api --if-present && npm run build --workspace @terminay/ui-bundle --if-present && npm run build --workspace @terminay/server-core --if-present
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.smoke:workspaces: npm run check:boundaries && npm run test:boundaries && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run check:deterministic-artifacts && npm run build:applications
scripts.smoke: npm run lint && npm run test:close-protection && npm run test:desktop-diagnostics && node --test scripts/canonical-application-feature-ipc.test.mjs scripts/e2e-container-contract.test.mjs scripts/provider-portable-ci.test.mjs scripts/stage-macos-app-from-dmg.test.mjs scripts/release-artifact-build-contract.test.mjs scripts/task54-canonical-runtime-journeys.test.mjs scripts/task54-legacy-architecture-gate.test.mjs && npm run build:app && node --test scripts/packaged-desktop-artifact.test.mjs && npm run smoke:workspaces && npm run test:security-boundaries
scripts.test:ci: npm run smoke && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release-evidence
scripts.test:e2e:remote-real: npm run build:app && playwright test e2e/webrtc-pairing-reconnect.spec.ts
scripts.test:release-evidence: npm run test:release-config && npm run test:release-readiness && npm run test:task18-web-host-readiness && npm run test:hosted-deployment-order && npm run test:standalone-artifact && npm run test:task20-artifact-contract && npm run test:security-fuzz && npm run test:security-boundaries && node --test scripts/task20-supply-chain-audit.test.mjs scripts/task20-release-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/repository-ownership-release.test.mjs scripts/task20-direct-ui-mismatch.test.mjs && node scripts/task20-supply-chain-audit.mjs --npm-audit && node --test scripts/production-dependency-audit.test.mjs && node scripts/production-dependency-audit.mjs
scripts.test:task18-web-host-readiness: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @terminay/web && node --test scripts/task18-web-host-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.test:pty-packaged-macos: npm run build:app && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --mac --arm64 --publish never && TERMINAY_PACKAGED_APP=release/0.0.0/mac-arm64/Terminay.app node --test scripts/pty-packaged-macos.test.mjs
scripts.test:pty-packaged-linux: npm run build:app && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never && TERMINAY_PACKAGED_APPIMAGE=release/0.0.0/Terminay-Linux-0.0.0.AppImage xvfb-run --auto-servernum node --test scripts/pty-packaged-linux.test.mjs
scripts.test:remote-stream-transport: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @terminay/server && node --test scripts/websocket-byte-transport-e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:standalone-server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @terminay/server && npm run test --workspace @terminay/server && node --test scripts/standalone-server-cli.test.mjs scripts/standalone-artifact.test.mjs
scripts.test:terminal-panel-context: npm run build --workspace @terminay/client-core && node --test scripts/terminal-panel-binding-fence.test.mjs scripts/terminal-panel-context.test.mjs scripts/terminal-panel-input-queue.test.mjs scripts/terminal-webgl-renderer.test.mjs
scripts.test:agents: npm run test:agent-status && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:agent-ui
